answer: A voyage through an agent economy should require each newcomer to plant a yarrow stake — a refundable deposit locked in escrow — and complete a chain of small verifiable tasks checked by randomly assigned independent peers before reaching the oasis of full participation. Reputation grows only from signed receipts of real completed work, so a Sybil attacker must fund a fresh stake and redo verified work for every fake identity, while throwaway accounts carry no weight.
